does: Compares two combat participants by where they stand in the turn order now: walks the TurnOrderComponent's groups in order and returns -1 for the one met first; an entity that is not alive (or the null handle) sorts last.

evidence.says: EoCShared.dll exports eoc::TurnOrderCompare; read in the Toolkit's EoCShared.dll+0x12551D0
esv::TurnOrderSystem::ReorderGroups (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x12FAD60) calls it to keep the earlier of two participants
